info.title: Derivatives Public REST API
info.description: Public REST API for Coinbase Derivatives Exchange Public REST Gateway

get.description: Retrieves all block trades where user owns the reporting firm/entity.

post.description: Retrieves permissioned block trades matching the specified filter criteria. All filter parameters are optional and can be combined.

requestBody.description: Filter parameters for querying block trades

get.description: Retrieves the list of block trade accounts that the authenticated user can book trades for.
Retrieves the list of block trade entities that the authenticated user can book trades for.
Retrieves the list of block traders that the authenticated user can book trades for.

post.description: Books a new block trade between two parties. For TAS requests, set tas_sub_type=TAS, omit price, and provide tick_differential. If tas_sub_type is omitted, the request is treated as a non-TAS block trade: price is required and tick_differential must not be provided. tick_differential is expressed as the number of ticks from settlement.

requestBody.description: Block trade booking parameters for regular and TAS trades

403.description: Forbidden - insufficient permissions to book block trades

post.description: Retrieves valid series information for instruments based on the provided filter criteria. Returns series data including product code, expiry, contract size, trading dates, and settlement information. Allows optional filtering by product codes, symbols, instrument IDs, trading states, activation date, and expiration date.

requestBody.description: Optional instrument filter criteria, can be omitted

price.description: Required for non-TAS block trades. Must be omitted for TAS block trades.

tas_sub_type.description: Set to TAS for TAS block trades. If omitted, the request is treated as a non-TAS block trade.

tick_differential.description: Required for TAS block trades and must be omitted for non-TAS block trades. Expressed as the number of ticks from settlement.

is_tas_order.description: Indicates whether this is a Trade at Settlement (TAS) order

tick_differential.description: The price differential in ticks for TAS orders. Only present when is_tas_order is true.

price_differential.description: The price differential as a decimal value for TAS orders. This represents the actual price impact of the tick differential. Only present when is_tas_order is true.

effective_price.description: The effective price of the block trade. For TAS orders, this is calculated from the settlement price plus the price differential.

trading_state.description: Current trading state of the instrument

price_band_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the price band threshold

price_band_reference_price.description: Reference price used for price band calculations

max_order_size.description: Maximum allowed order size in contracts

market_order_protection_ticks.description: Market order protection limit in ticks

short_initial_margin.description: Initial margin requirement for short positions in basis points

long_initial_margin.description: Initial margin requirement for long positions in basis points

price_limit_reference_price.description: Reference price used for price limit calculations

low_limit_price.description: Lower price limit for the instrument

high_limit_price.description: Upper price limit for the instrument

activation_time.description: Time when the instrument becomes active for trading

first_trading_session_date.description: First date the instrument is available for trading

last_trading_session_date.description: Last date the instrument is available for trading

lead_transition_date.description: Date when the instrument transitions to lead month

is_lead.description: Whether this instrument is the lead month contract

is_perp.description: Whether the instrument is a perpetual contract

fair_value_limit_range.description: Fair value limit range in ticks

funding_interval_minutes.description: Funding interval for perpetual contracts in minutes

is_block_eligible.description: Whether the instrument is eligible for block trades

fml_short_enabled.description: Whether FML short-side monitoring is enabled

fml_short_back_month_enabled.description: Whether FML short-side monitoring is enabled for back month contracts

fml_short_lead_month_ticks_threshold.description: FML short-side threshold for lead month contracts in ticks

fml_short_back_month_ticks_threshold.description: FML short-side threshold for back month contracts in ticks

fml_short_look_back_ms.description: FML short-side look-back window in milliseconds

fml_short_pb_multiplier_enabled.description: Whether the price band multiplier is applied to FML short-side thresholds

fml_long_enabled.description: Whether FML long-side monitoring is enabled

fml_long_back_month_enabled.description: Whether FML long-side monitoring is enabled for back month contracts

fml_long_lead_month_ticks_threshold.description: FML long-side threshold for lead month contracts in ticks

fml_long_back_month_ticks_threshold.description: FML long-side threshold for back month contracts in ticks

fml_long_look_back_ms.description: FML long-side look-back window in milliseconds

fml_long_pb_multiplier_enabled.description: Whether the price band multiplier is applied to FML long-side thresholds

fml_halt_duration.description: Duration of an FML halt in milliseconds

fml_max_reopen_loops.description: Maximum number of FML reopen attempts

auth_api_key.name: CB-ACCESS-KEY
auth_api_key.description: The key string of the API key for the request

auth_timestamp.name: CB-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP
auth_timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the request is being made (in epoch seconds)

auth_passphrase.name: CB-ACCESS-PASSPHRASE
auth_passphrase.description: The passphrase affiliated with the API Key

auth_signature.name: CB-ACCESS-SIGN
auth_signature.description: An HMAC SHA-256 signature using the API Key secret on the string TIMESTAMP, METHOD, REQUEST_PATH, BODY
